name: Audit Chain MCP
description: Optional Tool API plugins for chain status, window counts, export status and verify now, governed by MCP Sentinel.
project_description: Audit Chain MCP is the optional submodule of Audit Chain (drupal/audit_chain). It exposes four Tool API (drupal/tool) plugins governed by MCP Sentinel so an AI agent can inspect the tamper-evident audit chain without touching its contents: audit_chain_status (chain health from stored state), audit_chain_window_counts (keyed/unkeyed counts per 24h/7d/30d window), audit_chain_export_status (off-system evidence-export backlog), and audit_chain_verify_now (run scheduled verification on demand). Every tool extends AuditChainToolBase, which enforces the module's own permissions, re-checks access for PHP callers, resolves an MCP Sentinel governance profile, applies rate limiting and a response-size cap, and returns a single fixed refusal message. Results are reduced field by field so rows, metadata, IP addresses, user agents, hashes, seal MACs, prefix digests, key identifiers and seal reasons never reach a caller. The read tools require 'use audit chain mcp tools'; the Trigger-scoped verify tool additionally requires 'run audit chain verification via mcp'.
